About — Revl - Automatic Video Solution for Adventure Experiences

Revl’s mission has always been to empower people to capture, relive, and share their amazing experiences. The company has developed in-house AI to capture, edit, and deliver videos in real-time so customers are left with cinematic video souvenirs of their experience.

The company began in 2015 when Eric Sanchez, Nelson Vazquez, and Bruce Pla realized just how hard it was to create and edit fun videos of their kitesurfing and skydiving adventures. Revl believes editing videos should be easy and plans on leveraging their proprietary technology across the global experience economy market - from skydiving to cruise ships and everything in between.

Case Study: Falcon — Revl - Automatic Video Solution for Adventure Experiences
Revl automates the entire video creation process for Falcon Skydive.

Falcon Skydiving takes first time skydivers on a new experience and delivers a video with it. They are a medium sized Drop Zone outside of Kansas City capable of running up to 100 tandems in a day. After seeing significant growth in recent years, they needed to find ways to become more efficient.

After using Revl for the summer, Falcon also had the realization that their phone calls to the office had dropped dramatically. Guests were no longer calling to ask about their videos -- they had been delivered automatically the same day. They also saw an uptick in their social media presence from their guests posting the videos that fit Facebook and Instagram’s format.
Guests videos took a long time to reach the guests
